name: agent-plugins
description: Curated Claude Code plugin directory — local tools and recommended external plugins, all installable via /plugin install <name>@agent-plugins

metadata.description: Curated Claude Code plugin directory — local tools and recommended external plugins

plugins.name: aliyunlog
plugins.description: Enables AI to query Alibaba Cloud SLS (Log Service) logs via @alicloud/log Node.js SDK with environment and service-based quick lookup.

plugins.name: augment-mcp
plugins.description: Integrates Augment Context Engine MCP server for semantic codebase search and retrieval across repositories.

plugins.name: ecommerce-expert
plugins.description: E-commerce platform API knowledge base — SHEIN (173 endpoints) and Temu (124 endpoints) with full parameter specs, signing algorithms, and integration patterns

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: Discover and install agent skills from the skills.sh ecosystem when users ask about extending capabilities or finding tools for specific tasks.

plugins.name: mysql
plugins.description: Enables AI to execute SQL queries against MySQL databases via Node.js with multi-connection support for cross-database analysis.

plugins.name: postgresql
plugins.description: Enables AI to execute SQL queries against PostgreSQL databases via Node.js with multi-connection support for schema inspection and discovery.

plugins.name: shopify-ai-toolkit
plugins.description: Shopify development toolkit — themes, apps, Storefront API, Hydrogen, checkout extensions, Polaris, POS, and Liquid templating

plugins.name: ticktick
plugins.description: Manage TickTick (Dida365) tasks, projects, tags, habits, kanban columns, folders, focus sessions, and productivity statistics via the bundled CLI.

plugins.name: understand-anything
plugins.description: Transform codebases into interactive knowledge graphs with multi-agent analysis, visualization dashboards, and Q&A
